Hi Marta —

Thanks for the attachments — that helps. Quick clarifications from our side so we can avoid partial releases:

- The TX requirement is common. For Texas we need either the state-issued form with the billed-entity name that matches the W-9 or a blanket that explicitly calls out TX with the legal name/EIN that matches what will appear on the invoice.
- For any ship-from that lists a different legal entity (e.g., Shoreline West LLC) we need the affidavit to explicitly map that subsidiary to its EIN and confirm that Shoreline Retail, Inc. is authorized to be billed on its behalf.
- DocuSign is acceptable provided the signature is evidenced (auditable envelope) and the signer is the authorized officer — we will accept a DocuSign envelope ID or the completed PDF.

I pasted a one-paragraph template below you can drop into your legal/finance team and sign: 

---affidavit template start---
Shoreline Retail, Inc. hereby certifies that the entities listed on the attached schedule (Shoreline West LLC — EIN XX-XXXX1234; Shoreline Midwest LLC — EIN XX-XXXX5678) are subsidiaries/affiliates of Shoreline Retail, Inc. and that Shoreline Retail, Inc. is authorized to accept invoices and sales tax treatment on their behalf for transactions described in the attached schedule.

Signature: ____________________
Name/Title: __________________
Date: ______________________
---affidavit template end---

If you can return that signed (DocuSign envelope ID is fine) and confirm which EIN you prefer on invoice lines, Lauren/Marcus and I will map the POs and push the invoices for release.

Thanks — I’ll hold the request open until end-of-day 9/7 and escalate to Grace (Finance) if we need faster clearance.

—Priyom
